# ARNZO PDF Toolkit — Full Product Information

## Product identity
ARNZO PDF Toolkit is a free browser-based PDF utility website published by ARNZO. It is available at https://pdf.arnzo.com/. It is intended for people who need common PDF page organization and image conversion tasks without installing desktop software or creating an account.

## Short answer
ARNZO PDF Toolkit lets users merge, split, rotate, compress, extract and delete PDF pages, convert JPG/PNG images into PDF, and export PDF pages as PNG images. PDF content is processed locally in the browser; it is not uploaded to ARNZO servers for processing.

## Publisher
ARNZO — https://arnzo.com/

## Tools and exact behavior
### Merge PDF
Accepts two or more PDF files and copies their pages into one combined PDF. The user selects the files and downloads the merged output.

### Split PDF
Accepts one PDF and page numbers or ranges such as 1, 3-5, 8. Exports each selected page as an individual PDF inside a ZIP archive.

### Extract pages
Creates a single new PDF containing selected pages from one source PDF.

### Delete pages
Removes selected page numbers from one PDF and saves the remaining pages as a new PDF. Deleting every page is blocked.

### Rotate PDF
Rotates every page by 90, 180 or 270 degrees clockwise.

### Images to PDF
Accepts JPG and PNG image files. Each selected image is placed on a separate PDF page.

### PDF to images
Renders each page of one PDF as a PNG image and downloads the page images in a ZIP archive.

### Compress PDF
Renders PDF pages and embeds them as JPEG images at a selectable quality. This is image-based compression, not lossless PDF optimization. It does not preserve searchable/selectable text, hyperlinks, form fields or vector graphics. The resulting file may not be smaller than the original.

## Privacy and security
Files are read from the user's local device through browser file APIs. PDF parsing, editing, rendering, and generated downloads happen client-side. The application does not send PDF document contents to an ARNZO server. No user account or backend service is required for PDF processing. The website uses Google Fonts for typography; font requests do not include the user's PDF document contents.

## Device compatibility
The site is responsive and designed for modern desktop and mobile browsers with JavaScript, File API, Canvas, Blob and object URL support. Large or complex PDFs can consume substantial memory; practical limits depend on the device and browser.

## Getting started
1. Visit https://pdf.arnzo.com/.
2. Choose the tool from the PDF Tools list.
3. Select or drop files into the upload area.
4. Enter page ranges or choose a compression quality when prompted.
5. Select Process PDF and save the generated output.

## Frequently asked questions
**Is it free?** Yes, the tools are free to use and do not require an account.

**Are files uploaded?** No. PDF contents are processed locally in the browser, not uploaded to ARNZO servers.

**Can it merge PDFs?** Yes. Choose Merge PDF and select at least two PDFs.

**Can it split a PDF?** Yes. Select page numbers or ranges; each selected page is saved separately in a ZIP archive.

**Does compression preserve text?** No. The current compression tool rasterizes pages to JPEG images, so text is no longer searchable/selectable and links, forms and vector fidelity are not preserved.

**Can I use it on a phone?** Yes, in modern mobile browsers. Large PDFs may exceed available memory.
